Ask a player to choose a card

Source: R/players.R
sk_choose.Rd

Dispatches to the player's strategy and returns a single legal card.

Usage

sk_choose(
  player,
  hand,
  led,
  game_type,
  trick = character(0),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

player

An sk_player object.

hand

The player's current hand (sk_card or character vector).

led

The led card, or NULL if this player leads.

game_type

A single game-type string, one of sk_game_types().

trick

Cards already played to the current trick, in play order and including the led card. Defaults to character(0); when it is empty but led is supplied, led is taken as the whole trick so far.

call

The calling environment, used for error reporting.

Value

A single card code: a character scalar drawn from sk_legal_moves(hand, led, game_type).

See also

sk_legal_moves() for the set a choice is drawn from.

Other player functions: sk_mcts_move(), sk_player()

Examples

p <- sk_player("heuristic")
sk_choose(p, hand = c("HA", "H7", "CJ"), led = "HK", game_type = "spades")
#> [1] "HA"

# Leading, the heuristic sheds its cheapest card.
sk_choose(p, hand = c("HA", "H7", "CJ"), led = NULL, game_type = "spades")
#> [1] "H7"
